description: This file contains JavaScript code for UI interactions, including navigation setup, battery indicator, educational tips, firewall display, delete confirmation dialogs, form validation, and radio button styling, all within the 'comcast' namespace.

methods.name: setupLeftNavigation
methods.description: Initializes the left navigation menu, handling selection, folder toggling, and browser-specific fixes.

methods.name: setupBatteryIndicator
methods.description: Updates battery icon based on battery percentage.

methods.name: setupEducationalTip
methods.description: Sets up toggle for educational tips section.

methods.name: setupFirewallDisplay
methods.description: Handles toggle for firewall security level display.

methods.name: setupDeleteConfirmDialogs
methods.description: Attaches confirmation dialogs to delete links.

methods.name: setupFormValidation
methods.description: Configures form validation rules and custom methods.

methods.name: setupTooltipInHeader
methods.description: Initializes tooltip display on header elements.
